audience: website owners and marketers who track traffic with Simple Analytics

useCases.title: Check visitors and pageviews for a period
useCases.text: Gets total pageviews, unique visitors and median time on page for a website and date range, optionally for one page, country, referrer or device.

useCases.title: Show traffic over time
useCases.text: Gets pageviews and visitors per hour, day, week, month or year for a date range, so you can describe a trend.

useCases.title: Find top pages, referrers, countries or devices
useCases.text: Gets the top values of one dimension, such as pages, referrers, countries, UTM campaigns, browsers or operating systems, with pageviews and visitors.

useCases.title: Count how often custom events happened
useCases.text: Counts custom events on a website in a date range, for the event names you give or for all events.

useCases.title: Export raw page views or events
useCases.text: Exports raw, unsampled page views or events for a date range with only the fields you ask for, up to a row limit.
